name: svd_image_video

depth.note: SVD-XT does not consume the exported metric depth

motion.note: motion bucket controls amount of motion, not the exported motion vectors

ids.note: SVD-XT does not consume object IDs

camera_pose.note: SVD-XT has no camera trajectory or pose input

reference_frames.role: exactly one RGB reference image initializes the whole video; if omitted, the first ControlBundle beauty frame is used

seed.role: CUDA generator seed for the video

sampler_settings.role: steps, fps, motion_bucket_id and noise_aug_strength; unknown keys refused

color: ACEScg beauty is converted through OCIO to an sRGB reference image; external references are RGB images. SVD-XT generates 1024 by 576 sRGB frames, resized to the requested plate and converted through OCIO to ACEScg OpenEXR.

environment.gpu: NVIDIA CUDA with model CPU offload and UNet forward chunking
